statement: This request authorizes GoreeCloud Search Release Candidate #08 publication and isolated image-level candidate/rollback rehearsal from the exact reviewed source boundary only. It does not authorize production cutover, target-host changes, Stable promotion, compatibility-name retirement, or rollback-material deletion. Final target-runtime, real-provider, monitoring and alert-delivery, application-level recovery, physical Android, desktop/persisted-theme, and actual compiled GoreeCloud Browser acceptance remain separate required evidence.
